cases.name: fixed_window_exhausts_then_resets
cases.policy:
version: 2
rules:
  - action: allow
    target:
      agent: research
      tool: search
    rate_limit:
      max_calls: 2
      window_seconds: 60

cases.name: identity_keys_are_independent
cases.policy:
version: 2
rules:
  - action: allow
    target:
      tool: search
    rate_limit:
      max_calls: 1
      window_seconds: 60

cases.name: denial_and_approval_do_not_consume_quota
cases.policy:
version: 2
rules:
  - action: allow
    target:
      tool: search
    rate_limit:
      max_calls: 2
      window_seconds: 60
  - action: deny
    target:
      tool: search
      user: blocked
  - action: require_approval
    target:
      tool: search
      context:
        review: required

error_cases.name: v1_rejects_rate_limit
error_cases.policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: allow
    rate_limit:
      max_calls: 1
      window_seconds: 60

error_cases.name: v2_rejects_rate_limit_on_non_allow
error_cases.policy:
version: 2
rules:
  - action: throttle
    rate_limit:
      max_calls: 1
      window_seconds: 60

error_cases.name: v2_rejects_zero_limit

version: 2
rules:
  - action: allow
    rate_limit:
